name: Comments and Ratings for eCommerce
author: zamartz

sections.description:
When the Disqus plugin is active it replaces the comment form everywhere, including WooCommerce product reviews, and loads its scripts on product list and product pages where they cause errors. Comments and Ratings for eCommerce puts Disqus where it belongs on a shop:

  • The Disqus comment thread in a “Comments” tab on each product page, beside the WooCommerce “Reviews” tab, so both work.
  • The Disqus plugin’s own comments and scripts kept off product pages, so they do not clash with this plugin’s thread.
  • Each product’s thread is linked to Disqus by the product’s WordPress post ID.

Everything above is free and complete. Nothing in this plugin is locked or needs a license.

The settings are under ZAMARTZ > Settings > Plugins > Comments and Ratings for eCommerce, and the same settings are under WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Disqus Comments. Administrators and WooCommerce Shop Managers can change them.

Paid add-on

A separate paid add-on, sold on zamartz.com, adds more. It is a second plugin that you install beside this one; its settings appear in the same places as the free ones. Comments and Ratings for eCommerce: Paid Add-On adds:

  • More places for the comment thread: in place of the Reviews tab, under the product tabs, under the product summary, or inside any element you choose with a CSS selector.
  • Comment counts on product pages (below the title, below the SKU, below the price, or a CSS selector) and on the shop and category pages (above or below each product title, or a CSS selector).
  • Other identifiers for linking products to Disqus: the parent SKU, the variant SKU or the product slug, for the whole shop or per product, or one typed per product.
  • A “Disqus Comments” box on each product’s edit screen, with “Turn Disqus off on this product” and the product’s own identifier.
  • “Use the Disqus plugin’s shortname” to fill the shortname in for you.
  • Import of the setting from the older Woo Disqus Comments and Ratings plugin.
  • A network admin screen on multisite.

What this plugin sends elsewhere

  • Disqus: on product pages with the thread switched on, the visitor’s browser loads the comment thread from your-shortname.disqus.com. That is how Disqus works; see the Disqus privacy policy.
  • zamartz.com: only if a site administrator says yes to “Share anonymous events” in the ZAMARTZ admin (asked once, changeable under ZAMARTZ > Settings > General). The events are activate, deactivate (with the reason chosen, if any), delete, and a click on “Review Now”. Each sends the plugin’s name, the event, and a one-way hash of the site address; never the address itself, an email, a user or order details. Saying no sends nothing. See the Zamartz privacy policy.
  • The ZAMARTZ dashboard shows news from zamartz.com only after the same yes, or when you click “Load them now”.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce and the Disqus plugin (Disqus Comment System), and set Disqus up for your site.
  2. Install this plugin from Plugins > Add New, and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Disqus Comments (or ZAMARTZ > Settings > Plugins).
  4. Enter your Disqus shortname, switch on “Use Disqus on product pages” and “Show the comment thread”, and save.
sections.faq:
I do not see the Comments tab on my product page

Check that the product’s comments are open (the product’s Advanced tab, “Enable reviews”) and that your theme shows WooCommerce product tabs. With the paid add-on, also check that the product’s “Turn Disqus off on this product” switch is off.

Where is my paid license?

From version 4.0.0 the paid features are in a separate paid add-on. Your license and settings are kept on your site. Download the add-on from your account on zamartz.com, install it beside this plugin, and the paid features come back with no need to enter the license again.
sections.changelog:
4.0.1

  • Improved: the license screen of the paid add-on (shared ZAMARTZ admin 2.4.2): the saved license details are never printed, the “Saved” notes change in place after activating, deactivating or clearing, and the section’s text names the other screen the settings are on.
  • Fixed: deleting the plugin now also removes the paid add-on’s own scheduled license events (woo_disqus_license_check and woo_disqus_license_turn_off).
  • Changed: the ZAMARTZ admin updated to 2.4.2.

4.0.0

This is a major update.

  • Changed: the paid features moved to a separate paid add-on, available from zamartz.com. This plugin no longer holds license code or contacts zamartz.com for licenses. Sites with a paid license keep their license and settings, and see a one-time notice with the link to the add-on.
  • Changed: the “Disqus Comments” box on the product edit screen (“Turn Disqus off on this product” and the product’s own identifier) is part of the paid add-on, as it was paid in 3.1.1. This plugin shows no box on the product edit screen. A product’s saved “Turn Disqus off” applies only with the add-on and an active license; without them it is ignored, and kept, not deleted.
  • Changed: one settings section, shown both under ZAMARTZ > Settings > Plugins and under WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Disqus Comments, with one save. WooCommerce Shop Managers can now save it.
  • Changed: the ZAMARTZ admin updated to 2.4.1 (security fixes, assets loaded only where needed, translated with this plugin’s own text domain).
  • Changed: the text domain is now woo-dis-comments-and-ratings, the plugin’s WordPress.org slug, so WordPress.org language packs apply.
  • Fixed: a settings save could write any option whose name contained the plugin’s prefix, license options included; it now saves only this plugin’s listed settings.
  • Fixed: the Status screen showed the “comments” and “comment count” switches under each other’s names.
  • Fixed: on WooCommerce’s block product template, when the Product Details block draws no tab for the comments (for example with WooCommerce’s compatibility layer switched off), the thread now goes just after that block instead of nowhere, and a page never gets two thread elements.
  • Fixed: an empty script was loaded on every page of the site; the plugin now loads its script only on product pages with the thread, and nothing on other pages.
  • Fixed: the admin script and style loaded on every admin screen.
  • Fixed: on a site in another language, a translated “Free” label could switch features on or off.
  • Fixed: deleting the plugin left settings, per-product values and the scheduled license check behind. Without the add-on installed it now removes the add-on’s own license events on every site; the event names older Zamartz plugins share are removed only on a single site and only when no plugin uses them.
  • Fixed: the Disqus shortname is checked (letters, digits, hyphens) before it is used in a web address.
  • Compatible with WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.3, PHP 7.4 to 8.5, WooCommerce order storage in custom tables and the cart and checkout blocks.

3.1.1

  • Updated to support new product IDs. You may have to log in to your account to retrieve your new ID and activate your plugin again.

3.1.0

  • Security: fixed a path traversal in the admin settings.
  • Improved input checks for the admin settings tabs.
  • Updated compatibility with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce.

3.0.0

  • Level set (no substantial updates).

2.0.5

  • ZAMARTZ core update for the API.
  • Tested with WordPress 6.0 and WooCommerce 6.

2.0.4

  • ZAMARTZ core update.
  • Fixed turning Disqus off on single products.
  • Fixed the custom placement on product pages.

2.0.3

  • Fixed “Undefined property: Woo_Disqus_Comments_Front”.
  • The “Product Detail Pages” section can be hidden.

2.0.2

  • Design and opt-in updates.

2.0.1

  • Fixed an error in set_plugin_api_data().

2.0.0

  • Major update: works on its own or with the Disqus plugin, with paid comment counts on product list and product pages.

1.2.0

  • Stops the Disqus plugin’s own loading and detects comments through WP_Comment.

1.1.2

  • Removed a second load of the Disqus script on post pages.

1.1.1

  • Free version switch update.

1.1.0

  • HTTP calls use HTTPS when needed.

1.0.7

  • Plugin address correction.

1.0.6

  • File versioning updates.

1.0.5

  • Compatibility with the new Disqus script.

1.0.4

  • Upload error fix.

1.0.3

  • Upload error fix.

1.0.2

  • Upload error fix.

1.0.1

  • Fixed a debug error with the URL query.

1.0

  • First release.
